items.title: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver’s licenses during data breach
items.summary: The ridesharing giant said drivers' license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.creator: Sarah Perez
